name: Campingplatz Ortnerhof
beschreibung: The Ortnerhof campsite is located in the tranquil municipality of Ruhpolding in Austrian Tirol and is surrounded by an imposing mountain landscape. The location offers an excellent starting point for extensive hikes and cycling tours into the surrounding countryside. The amenities include comfortable pitches with electricity and water connections as well as a modern, well-maintained sanitary building. The quiet and manageable site creates a relaxed atmosphere that is especially appreciated by families and nature-loving couples. A small shop on the grounds provides guests with fresh rolls and regional products to start the day. The personal attention from the campsite operators and the direct connection to the mountains of Tirol guarantee a relaxing camping holiday in the Alpine region.
